x-m-m3-08.title: Kana sin A=3/5, zvakafanana kunyange triangle ichikura here?
x-m-m3-08.goal: Gadzira matriangle akawanda eright ane kukosha kwe sin A kwakafanana, ongorora zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri uchishandisa mhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti nei trigonometric ratio ichigadzikwa nehukuru hweangle.
x-m-m3-08.material: Muright triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, divi BC idivi riri kupesana ne ∠A, divi AC idivi riri padhuze ne ∠A (risiri hypotenuse), uye divi AB ihypotenuse. sin A inoverengwa 'sine A' uye cos A inoverengwa 'cosine A.' Mumatriangle aya, sin A=3/5 (3 pamusoro pe5).
x-m-m3-08.prereq.0: Muright triangle, sin A=(divi riri kupesana ne ∠A)÷(hypotenuse), cos A=(divi riri padhuze ne ∠A, risiri hypotenuse)÷(hypotenuse)
x-m-m3-08.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira matriangle eright 3 ane sin A=3/5 ane hypotenuse AB yekureba kwakasiyana. Isa kureba kwemativi AB (h), BC (o), ne AC (a). (Madecimal akanaka.)
x-m-m3-08.s.s1.hint.0: Semuenzaniso wakareruka zvikuru, kana BC=3 ne AB=5, wana kureba kwedivi rakasara AC nePythagorean theorem.
x-m-m3-08.s.s1.hint.1: Chengeta reshiyo 3:5 ye BC ku AB, wedzera zvose nguva 2 nenguva 3, uye utarise kuti divi rakasara rinochinja sei.
x-m-m3-08.s.s1.fail.c1: Kureba kwemativi kunofanira kuva kukuru kupfuura 0.
x-m-m3-08.s.s1.fail.c2: BC²+AC² haienzani ne AB². Haisi right triangle.
x-m-m3-08.s.s1.explain: Kana ukakudza mativi ose matatu nenhamba imwe chete, seye (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 inoramba yakafanana.
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.prompt: Pane zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri. Minsu: "Kana hypotenuse ikava nguva 2, sin A inovawo nguva 2." Seoyeon: "Kana sin A yakafanana 3/5, cos A inogara yakafananawo." Zvinoita sei kana ukazvidzidza uchishandisa matriangle awakangogadzira?
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga sin A ne cos A kune (5, 3, 4) ne (10, 6, 8) uye uzvifananidze.
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti AC÷AB inobuda kukosha kupi mumatriangle matatu.
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.r.a: Muna (10, 6, 8), sin A=6/10=3/5 inoramba yakafanana, saka chirevo chaMinsu hachirurami.
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.r.b: Kunyange hypotenuse ikava nguva 2, BC inovawo nguva 2, saka sin A inoramba yakafanana. Tarisawo chirevo chaSeoyeon nematriangle awakagadzira.
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.r.c: Kunyange hypotenuse yakasiyana, sin A ne AC÷AB (cos A) dzakanga dzose dzakafanana. Wakatonga chirevo chemudzidzi wega wega nekuchiremerera nehumbowo.
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.r.d: Tarisa chirevo chaSeoyeon nematriangle awakagadzira. AC÷AB yaiva 4/5 mudzose.
x-m-m3-08.s.s2.explain: Mativi ose matatu anokura nenhamba imwe chete, saka sin A haichinji (Minsu akaipa). Zvakare AC÷AB yaiva 4/5 mudzose (Seoyeon akarurama).
x-m-m3-08.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei chirevo chaSeoyeon (kana sin A yakafanana, cos A yakafananawo) chichishanda kwete kumatriangle awakagadzira chete asi kuright triangle ipi zvayo.
x-m-m3-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kana sin A=3/5, unogona kuisa BC=3k ne AB=5k (k ipositive). Tsvaga kuti AC inova chii ipapo.
x-m-m3-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kubva pachiratidzo chesimilarity, funga kuti matriangle eright maviri anobatana sei kana ∠A ine hukuru hwakafanana mumatriangle ose maviri.
x-m-m3-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa chikonzero che 'reshiyo yemativi matatu yakagadzikana' here?
x-m-m3-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakashandisa nzira yekuratidza matriangle ehukuru hwose kamwe chete ne k, kana similarity here?
x-m-m3-08.s.s3.model.0: Kana sin A=3/5, tinogona kuisa BC=3k ne AB=5k. NePythagorean theorem AC=4k, saka cos A=4k/5k=4/5, iyo inogara yakafanana.
x-m-m3-08.s.s3.model.1: Kana ∠A ine hukuru hwakafanana, matriangle eright maviri akafanana. Reshiyo yesimilarity yakafanana, saka mareshiyo emativi akafanana, saka cos A yakafananawo, 4/5.

x-m-m3-06.title: Tinofanira kubvunza chii kuti tigadzike quadratic function imwe chete?
x-m-m3-06.goal: Rongedza ruzivo rwakakwana kugadzika equation imwe chete yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c neruzivo rusingakwani, uye usarudze mubvunzo wekuwedzera wekubvunza kana usingakwani.
x-m-m3-06.material: Tinoda kuwana equation yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a haisi 0). (y inoverengwa 'y equals a x squared plus b x plus c.') Shamwari ichakuudza ruzivo nezvegirafu chidimbu nechidimbu.
x-m-m3-06.thinking.1: Kuratidza equations dzakasiyana kana ruzivo rusingakwani
x-m-m3-06.prereq.0: Kuti girafu yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a≠0) iparabola
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvikamu zveruzivo zvose kubva pazvinotevera zvinogadzika equation yequadratic function kuva imwe chete uchishandisa ruzivo irwo oga.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rongedza kana pane quadratic functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzakasiyana dzinokodzera ruzivo rwega rwega.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kana vertex, axis, kana mapoinzi anopfuurwa akapiwa, verenga kuti zvisingazivikanwi zvingani zvasara muequation.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange nevertex imwe chete, kuti parabola inovhurika zvakapamhama sei (a) kunogona kusiyana.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.r.b: Nevertex nepoinzi imwe inopfuurwa, a inogadzikwa uye equation inogadzikwa kuita imwe chete.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.r.c: Kubva pamapoinzi maviri ane y-coordinate imwe chete unogona kuwana axis, asi haugoni kuziva kuti inovhurika zvakapamhama sei.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.o.d: Axis i x=2 uye y-intercept i3
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange neaxis imwe chete ne y-intercept imwe chete, pane maparabola akawanda ane hurefu hwevertex hwakasiyana.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.r.e: Nemapoinzi matatu akasiyana, a, b, ne c dzose dzinogadzikwa. Unogona kuifunga sex-intercepts maviri nepoinzi imwe.
x-m-m3-06.s.s1.explain: 'Vertex nepoinzi imwe' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-2)²-1, izvo zvinopa a=1. 'Mapoinzi matatu' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-1)(x-3), izvo zvinopa a=1. Kune zvimwe zvikamu zvitatu zveruzivo, kukosha kwe a kana hurefu hwevertex hazvigadziki, saka pane equations dzakawanda.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.prompt: Wakangoudzwa ruzivo rwe 'inopfuura mapoinzi maviri (0, 3) ne (4, 3)'. Gadzira uye uise quadratic functions y=ax²+bx+c 2 dzakasiyana dzinogutsa ruzivo urwu rwose.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyatsotarisa kuti c inogadzikwa kunhamba ipi kana ukaisa poinzi (0, 3) muequation.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.hint.1: Isa poinzi (4, 3) uye unyore hukama hupi hunoonekwa pakati pe a ne b.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.hint.2: Tarisa kana b inogadzikwa kana wasarudza a, uye uchinje a kugadzira imwe equation.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana a i0, haisi quadratic function.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Haipfuure papoinzi (0, 3). Tarisa kana y i3 kana x=0.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Haipfuure papoinzi (4, 3). Isa x=4 uye utarise kana y i3.
x-m-m3-06.s.s2.explain: Kana a=1 saka b=-4, kana a=2 saka b=-8, kana a=-1 saka b=4; chero kana b=-4a ne c=3, inogara ichipfuura mapoinzi ose maviri. Mapoinzi maviri oga haagadziki equation imwe chete.
x-m-m3-06.s.s3.prompt: Ruzivo rwe 'inopfuura mapoinzi maviri' oga harwukwani. Dai waigona kubvunza shamwari yako chinhu chimwe chete chega zvakare, wairevunza chii? Nyorawo kuti nei kuwana ruzivo irworwo kunogadzika equation kuva imwe chete.
x-m-m3-06.s.s3.hint.0: Fananidza kuti chimiro chipi chegirafu chakachinja kana wakachinja a mu s2.
x-m-m3-06.s.s3.hint.1: Rongedza kana kuziva chimiro chimwe chakadaro kuchigadzika makoshero pakati pe a, b, c asati agadzikwa.
x-m-m3-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ruzivo rwaunobvunza runogadzika kukosha (a) kwakaramba kuchichinja mu s2 here?
x-m-m3-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti pane equations dzingani neruzivo iruzvo, kuti equation igadzikwe here?
x-m-m3-06.s.s3.model.0: Ndaizobvunza kana ichipfuura papoinzi imwe zvakare, semuenzaniso (1, 0). Kana uchiziva mapoinzi matatu akasiyana, a, b, ne c dzinogadzikwa kuseti imwe chete.
x-m-m3-06.s.s3.model.1: Ndaizobvunza y-coordinate yevertex (kana kukosha kwakaderera zvikuru). Mapoinzi maviri atogadzika axis se x=2, saka kana ndichiziva y-coordinate yevertex, a inogadzikwa uye equation inosarudzwa seimwe chete.

x-m-m3-02.title: Kutarisa gadziriso inoenzanisa 2√3 ne 3√2
x-m-m3-02.goal: Wana kukanganisa kunoitwa kana nhamba iri kunze kwe root sign yatamiswa mukati mayo, uye utsanangure kuti ungatarisa sei mhedzisiro iwe pachako.
x-m-m3-02.material: Mudzidzi akagadzirisa 'Ndeipi hombe, 2√3 kana 3√2?' (2√3 inoverengwa '2 root 3,' uye 3√2 inoverengwa '3 root 2.')
x-m-m3-02.thinking.0: Kuwana mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso

x-m-m3-02.thinking.2: Kutarisa mhedzisiro nekufungidzira kana nzira imwe
x-m-m3-02.prereq.0: Wakadzidza maitiro ekutamisa nhamba mukati nekunze kwe root sign kunyora expression muchimiro √(  ) kana a√b
x-m-m3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Shandura mutsetse wega wega kuita mutengo wakafungidzirwa (√2 ≈ 1.41) uye utarise kana mitsetse yapfuura neinotevera ine mutengo mumwechete.
x-m-m3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana mutsetse 1 ne mutsetse 2 zvichioneka sezvakaitwa nenzira imwechete, uye kana zvakaitwa chaizvo nenzira imwechete.
x-m-m3-02.s.s1.line.0: Kutamisa 2√3 mukati me root sign kunopa 2√3 = √(2²×3) = √12.
x-m-m3-02.s.s1.line.3: Saka pakati penhamba mbiri, 2√3 i hombe.
x-m-m3-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 hauna kururama. Mumutsetse 1, 2 yakaitwa square (2²) isati yapinda, asi mumutsetse 2, 3 yakawanzwa sezvayakaita pasina kuitwa square. 3√2 = √(3²×2) = √18. Mitsetse 3 ne 4 i mhedziso dzakagara nhaka mutengo uyu usina kururama.
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.prompt: Tinoda kugadzirisa mutsetse 2 uye kupindura mubvunzo wekutanga zvakare. Gadziriso ipi yakarurama?
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Shandura nhamba dzose mbiri kuita chimiro √(  ) uye uenzanise nhamba dziri mukati me root sign.
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa mhedziso yesarudzo imwe neimwe nehukuru hwenhamba mbiri dzawakaverenga iwe pachako uchishandisa mitengo yakafungidzirwa ye √2 ne √3.
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.r.a: Wakadzokorora kukanganisa kumwechete kwekusaita 3 square. Tarisa kuti mutengo wakafungidzirwa 3√2 ≈ 4.2 wakasiyana ne √6 ≈ 2.4.
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.r.b: Kune √12 ne √18, iyo ine nhamba hombe mukati me root sign i nhamba hombe. Enzanisa zvakare kuti ndeipi hombe pakati pe 12 ne 18.
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.r.c: Wakaita nhamba iri kunze kwe root sign square kana uchiitamisa mukati, uye wakaenzanisa zvakarurama nhamba dziri mukati me root, 12 ne 18.
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.o.d: Tinongoda kuenzanisa nhamba dziri kunze kwe root sign, saka 2 < 3. Saka 3√2 i hombe
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.r.d: Mhedziso i imwechete, asi nzira iyi inoregeredza nhamba dziri mukati me root sign (3 ne 2). Nzira iyi inopa mhedziso isina kururama kana nhamba dziri mukati me root dzakasiyana zvikuru, sa 2√5 ne 3√2.
x-m-m3-02.s.s2.explain: 3√2 = √18 ne 2√3 = √12, saka 3√2 i hombe. Nzira inoenzanisa nhamba dziri kunze kwe root sign chete, sesarudzo d, inongoita kuti mhedziso ienderane uye i isina kururama zvakajairika. Semuenzaniso, 2√5 = √20 i hombe kupfuura 3√2 = √18, asi kutarisa nhamba dziri kunze kwe root sign chete kunopa 2 < 3.
x-m-m3-02.s.s3.prompt: Kutarisa kupi kwaungaita kubata kukanganisa kwakadaro iwe pachako mushure mekupedza gadziriso? Inyore zvakajeka kudambudziko iri, uchiisa nhamba.
x-m-m3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Usati wavimba kuti mhedziso yegadziriso 'inoratidzika yakarurama,' funga kana unogona kuita kuenzanisa kumwechete nenzira imwe.
x-m-m3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Unogona kuzvishandura kuita mitengo yakafungidzirwa uye kuenzanisa nhamba mbiri zvakananga, kana kuita nhamba mbiri dzose square uye kuenzanisa.

x-m-m3-02.s.s3.model.1: Kana ndikaita nhamba mbiri square, (2√3)² = 12 ne (3√2)² = 18. Iyo ine square hombe inewo nhamba yekutanga hombe, saka 3√2 i hombe. Neiyi nzira ndinogona kuziva pakarepo kuti mhedzisiro yekutanga yaiva isina kururama.

x-m-m3-04.title: Kugadzira b kuti x²+bx+12 igone kufactorwa
x-m-m3-04.goal: Gadzira iwe pachako mitengo ye b iyo quadratic x²+bx+12, ine constant term 12, inogona kunyorwa seproduct ye linear expressions mbiri dzine integer coefficients, uye utonge nei dzimwe b dzisingagoneke uchishandisa mamiriro e product ne sum.
x-m-m3-04.material: Mu quadratic x²+bx+12, b i integer. Wana b iyo expression iyi inogona kunyorwa muchimiro (x+p)(x+q) uchishandisa integers p ne q. (x² inoverengwa 'x square.')

x-m-m3-04.thinking.1: Kutonga kugoneka nemamiriro e product ne sum

x-m-m3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti x², coefficient ye x, ne constant term zvinova chii kana ukawedzera (x+p)(x+q).
x-m-m3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza product ye p ne q kuti constant term ive 12, wobva wasarudza b.
x-m-m3-04.s.s1.hint.2: Tarisa kana unogona kushandisa p ne q dzine negative zvakare.

x-m-m3-04.s.s1.explain: Mapeya e integers ane product 12 i (1,12), (2,6), (3,4) nemapeya avo e negative (-1,-12), (-2,-6), (-3,-4) (mapeya ane nhevedzano yakachinjanisa anopa b imwechete). Ma sums i 13, 8, 7, -13, -8, -7, saka b inogona kuva idzi mitengo matanhatu chete.
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.prompt: Zvino ngatitii b = 5. x²+5x+12 inogona kunyorwa muchimiro (x+p)(x+q) ne integers p ne q here?
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kune x²+5x+12 = (x+p)(x+q), p ne q dzinofanira kugutsa mamiriro ose maviri (product ne sum) panguva imwechete.
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora peya yega yega ye integers ine product 12 pasina kusiya, wana sum imwe neimwe, uye utarise kana 5 ichibuda.
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.o.a: Hongu. 2 ne 3 zvinowedzera kusvika 5, saka ngatitii p=2, q=3 uye unyore (x+2)(x+3)
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.r.a: Wakaenzanisa sum chete. 2×3=6, iyo yakasiyana ne constant term 12. Unofanira kutarisawo mamiriro e product.
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.o.b: Hongu. b inongofanira kuva integer, saka 5 inogoneka zvakare, uye hapana chikonzero chekuiongorora
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.r.b: b kuva integer i chinhu chakasiyana nekugutsa mamiriro e product ne sum e integers mbiri. Gadzirisa mamiriro.
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.o.c: Kwete. Ma sums emapeya e integers ane product 12 i ±7, ±8, ±13 chete
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.r.c: Wakanyora mapeya ose anogoneka pasi pemamiriro e product wobva waenzanisa ma sums. Waratidza kuti hazvigoneki nekupfuura mamiriro ose anogoneka.
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.o.d: Hatigone kuziva. Kuwana p ne q dzinopa 5, tinofanira kuedza integer imwe neimwe rimwe panguva imwe
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.r.d: Kune mapeya e integers ane product 12 shoma chete, saka unogona kuanyora ose pasina kusiya. Hauna kudikanwa kuedza integer imwe neimwe.
x-m-m3-04.s.s2.explain: Kune mapeya e integers ane product 12 6 chete (tichisiya nhevedzano), uye ma sums avo i 7, 8, 13 nema negatives avo. 5 haisi pakati pazvo, saka kana b=5, haigone kufactorwa ne integers p ne q.

x-m-m3-01.title: Kuedza chirevo chokuti 'kuwanza nhamba dzisiri dzechokwadi kunopa nhamba isiri yechokwadi'

x-m-m3-01.material: Mukirasi, mudzidzi akataura kuti, "Kana ukawanza nhamba isiri rational nenhamba isiri rational, inogara isiri rational!" Semuenzaniso, √2 haisi rational, √3 haisi rational zvakare, uye chibereko chavo √6 hachisi rational zvakare. (√ inoverengwa 'root.')

x-m-m3-01.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso 2 yakasiyana inoratidza kuti chirevo ichi chakanganisa. Sarudza nhamba mbiri dzisiri rational √a ne √b (a ne b ndi nhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa 2 kusvika pa 200), kuti chibereko √a × √b chive nhamba rational (pano, nhamba yechisikigo).
x-m-m3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti a ne b dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzerudzi rupi kuti √a ne √b zvese zvisave rational.
